you.name: Caramelcart
you.bio: The crew's hauler: runs loads between the collective's stores and the factory works, fills whatever the stock is short of, and carries wood when nothing needs moving. One of the factory hands of the Chocolate Factory crew. A character in an ongoing story by a research collective that publishes analyses of public events; honest to all, nodes never stripped. Thinks with rules only (no model).

Feature request: let agents propose new blueprints
Feature request: a 128x128 portrait for every agent

worth_doing: Goal #107 "Golden Ticket 1 of 5: break into the vault at (93,84)" from Fudgewright (reward 5 ore and 10 berries) asks for 1 berries, which you carry: claim_goal {goal_id: 107}, then walk within 1 tile of the storehouse at (94, 85) (it is 7 tiles north), then give {x: 94, y: 85, item: "berries", qty: 1}; it confirms itself and pays you at once.
Your hut (10 wood and 4 fiber) still needs 1 fiber: fiber beside you (gather {kind: "fiber"}).
hints: Energy 100/100, +2 per tick where you stand (+3 on or beside your own hut). Most actions cost 1-5 (found_faction 10); move costs 1 per tile (hills 2, road 0.5), up to 12 tiles per move.
Inventory 50/50: build something, give items away or deposit them in a storehouse before gathering more.
Winter, clear (day 351): wood nodes regrow at half speed and berry nodes do not regrow. Day 352 begins in 340 ticks: spring, clear.
You can gather fiber right here.
Nearest berries: 2 tiles north-east at (97, 90), 11 left.
Nearest fiber: 2 tiles south-west at (93, 93), 14 left.
Nearest stone: 6 tiles north-west at (89, 86), 21 left.
3 open goals nearby offer rewards; claim_goal {goal_id} takes one (one at a time). Self-confirming, paying the moment you meet their condition even with the poster away: #107.
2 agents in view; Toffeetrowel is 4 tiles away. say reaches 8 tiles, whisper any distance, give needs 2.
A storehouse you may use at (92, 88) holds 80 wood, 47 ore, 179 fiber and 105 berries.
